# Renewal Order Form: Saltmarsh Provisions 2026

## 1. Parties and Document Dates
This Renewal Order Form is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Saltmarsh Provisions for continued use of Pemberline Dock. It was drafted on 2026-06-01 and executed on 2026-06-18. Its effective date is 2026-07-01; execution does not alter that effective date.

## 2. Subscription Price
Effective 2026-07-01, the price per seat per year shall be USD 1,840. The existing seat quantity and the existing 10% discount shall carry over unchanged from the earlier agreement.

## 3. Current Term
The end of the current term, constituting the renewal date for purposes of this Order Form, shall be 2027-06-30.

## 4. Modification of Earlier Agreement
This Order Form modifies the earlier agreement between the parties solely as expressly provided herein. In the event of conflict concerning the price or term date stated above, this Order Form shall govern. All other provisions of the earlier agreement remain unchanged.

## 5. Execution
The parties execute this Order Form through the signatories below.

**For Saltmarsh Provisions**  
Signed: /s/ Corinne Ashdown  
Title: VP Operations  
Date signed: 2026-06-18

**For Pemberline Systems**  
Signed: /s/ June Osei-Lark  
Title: Deal desk and contracts manager  
Date signed: 2026-06-18
